activities.title: Linear equations · spaced review
activities.summary: Sign errors when moving a term across the equals sign.
detail: 3 of 5 items failed on the same step: moving a term across = without flipping its sign.
She flagged two as "silly mistake"; the pattern says otherwise - third time this fortnight.
Routed a focused re-teach of inverse operations before the next review.

items.label: Q1
items.note: Wrote 3x = 11 − 7. Sign not flipped when moving −7 across =.
why: Moved −7 across the = but kept it negative. It should flip to +7, giving 3x = 11 + 7 = 18.

items.label: Q2
items.note: Correct.

items.label: Q3
items.note: Wrote 5x = 16 − 4. Same sign error as Q1.
why: Same sign slip as Q1: −4 crossing the = should become +4, giving 5x = 16 + 4 = 20.

items.label: Q4
items.note: Correct.

items.label: Q5
items.note: Lost the sign on −2x. Flagged as "silly mistake".
why: Sign lost on the final divide: −4 ÷ −2 = +2, so x = 2, not −2.

activities.title: Substitution into expressions
activities.summary: Substituted values into the wrong term on the harder items.
detail: First 5 (single-term) items correct; last 5 (two-term) items mostly wrong.
Consistent with a shaky grasp of the prerequisite, not carelessness.
This is the likely root cause feeding the linear-equations struggle.

items.label: Q6
items.note: Computed 3×4 + 2×4. Substituted a into both terms.
why: Substituted a=4 into both terms. The 2b term takes b=5, so it should be 2×5 = 10, giving 12 + 10 = 22.

items.label: Q7
items.note: Swapped m and n.
why: Swapped the values: m=3 and n=8, so it should read 5×3 − 8 = 7.

items.label: Q8
items.note: Correct (single term).

items.label: Q9
items.q: Evaluate ab + c when a=2, b=3, c=4
items.note: Left c out of the sum.
why: Stopped after ab = 6 and never added c. Should be 6 + 4 = 10.

items.label: Q10
items.note: Correct (single term).
